description: This file defines the 'Sign' class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically within the MathTrig calculation namespace. It provides functionality to determine the sign of a number, handling both single values and arrays.

classes.name: Sign
classes.description: Provides a static method to evaluate the sign of a number, supporting both scalar and array inputs.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Determines the sign of a given number or array of numbers, returning 1, 0, or -1 for positive, zero, and negative values respectively. Handles validation and error management.
